_comment: Names of Crackdown's XDK D3D runtime functions, as read in their code (tools/d3d_roles.py; docs/D3D.md phase D0). Address -> [name, what it does].
0x826ACC90: atomic increment of the resource's count (+4); at 1, a parent resource of type 4 is referenced too
0x826ACD08: atomic decrement of the count; at 0, the parent released and the resource destroyed (sub_826AC6C8)
0x826ACDB0: the common word's type, a texture's refined by its dimension (+48 bits 9-10, the array bit at +32), a surface of a volume texture 16
0x826ACFE8: a GPU texture format's block width and height in texels, to *r4 then *r5
0x826AD108: r3-r5 a level's sizes aligned in place to the format's blocks (sub_826ACFE8), the pitch and the depth; r3 its bytes, 4 KB rounded
0x826AD598: the width, height and depth from the fetch constant's +36 by its dimension (+48), +1 (or +3 with +40 bit 31), to *r4, *r5, *r6
0x826B0AA0: PA_CL_VTE_CNTL 0x43F or 0x400, PA_CL_CLIP_CNTL clip_disable with the viewport off; dirty 0x20, 0x80
0x826B0488: the bias as both polygon offsets, PA_SU_SC_MODE_CNTL poly offset enables unless scale and bias are 0
0x826B1EE0: the target's surface, COLOR_INFO (2_10_10_10 _AS_ variant fixed), viewport for target 0, query flag, color mask
0x826B2218: the depth surface, DEPTH_INFO, 0x2203, hi-z pitch when tiled, query flag, z and stencil enables
0x826AF370: the window scissor registers 0x2080-0x2082 (a tile at a time when tiled: bin mask, window offset, rect)
0x826B1B60: the scissor as set (+12396), the viewport clipped to it, the window scissor mirror (+10308), its packets
0x826AF650: the viewport as set (+12368, clamped to the surface or the tiling), its scale and offset (+10376), the scissor; dirty bits 21-26
0x826B1C60: a D3DVIEWPORT9 (words to floats) into the viewport function
0x826AF2D8: a surface into SURFACE_INFO and the multisample word, the runtime's scissor and viewport; dirty bits 57 and 36
0x826C0D38: an event, occlusion (its blocks summed) or extent query's result, S_FALSE while the GPU is behind its frame (the command buffer kicked when issued this frame)
0x826AFE10: a D3DCOLOR into RB_BLEND_RED-ALPHA as floats; dirty bits 33-36
0x826AFFD8: the value kept; RB_DEPTHCONTROL bit 1 with a depth surface; dirty 0x800, 0x20000
0x826B0358: PA_CL_CLIP_CNTL low 6 bits, the word 10292 0x1000; dirty 0x80, bit 44
0x826B03C0: both polygon offset scales (times the runtime factor) and their enables; dirty bits 45, 43, 0x40
0x826B2698: a user clip plane (16 bytes at +10144); dirty bit 54 - index of +32
0x826AFAF0: the blend word as set, bits 0-4
0x826AFB80: the blend word as set, bits 8-12
0x826AFEB0: RB_BLEND_RED-ALPHA back to a D3DCOLOR (fmadds, fctidz)
0x826B1580: the stage byte at +11644; with a filter flag, fetch constant word 3 bits 25-27 from the table
0x826B1270: the stage LOD byte bit 1 (+11722), fetch constant word 4 low bits
0x826B13F8: the stage LOD byte bit 0 (+11722), fetch constant word 4 low bits
0x826AF038: stage's fetch constant from the texture's, mip range clamped; old texture released (fence or release list)
0x826B1D30: stream's vertex fetch constant, stride byte; old buffer released
0x826B1180: fetch constant words 3-4: min filter and anisotropy
0x826B1308: fetch constant words 3-4: mag filter and anisotropy
0x826B1E50: declaration kept at +12156; old one released
0x826B3458: shader at +12412, dirty bits, the shader's fetch constant program
0x826B3848: shader at +12416, dirty bits, the shader's fetch constant program
0x826B3178: a bit a register at word 2496
0x826B31D8: a bit a register at word 2500
0x826B3238: a word a register at word 2504
0x826B3290: a word a register at word 2520
0x826AF950: blend flags bit 31; render targets' blend words
0x826AFCE0: blend flags bit 30; render targets' blend words
0x826C4C70: dcbf over [r3, r4) then sync (no-ops recompiled)
0x826C5EA0: dirty 64-byte constant groups as type-0 packets into the command buffer
0x826C5B00: dirty registers of a word as type-0 packets
0x826B9FF8: flushes the dirty state, then DRAW_INDX (DMA indices); occlusion query variant
0x826B91E0: flushes, takes a vertex block, writes its fetch constant and an auto draw past the cursor; returns the block
0x826B9C08: flushes the dirty state, then DRAW_INDX (auto indices)
0x826B9688: BeginVertices (sub_826B91E0), the vertices memcpy'd into its block, the cursor moved past the draw (+48 = +13076)
0x826B96D0: flushes, takes vertex and index blocks, writes the fetch constant and an indexed draw; returns an HRESULT
0x826BD300: the bins a predicated packet runs for (SET_BIN_SELECT); tile zero by default
0x826BE578: EDRAM copy to a texture: state, copy draw, cache events
0x826C0B38: r3 a query, r4 D3DISSUE_BEGIN (2) / END (1): occlusion queries (type 9) through sub_826C05C8, event queries (10) as EVENT_WRITE / EVENT_WRITE_EXT
0x826BB950: the ring buffer and the command processor set up
0x826BCA98: frame end: present packet, buffers rotated
0x826C3750: a recorded command buffer's dirty state and replay
0x826C3440: a new block of the release list, from the command buffer
0x826BAC90: waits for the GPU to free ring space
0x826AC8F0: CPU lock of a resource: its fence waited, the locked pages' cache flushed (or the range added to the device's pending one from another thread), the locked lines widened, the lock count raised
0x826BF8C0: a clear's draw of one target: stencil reference, state group, the fast clear's packed color, the rects under each tile's bins
0x826BFD88: the clear under its rect wrapper sub_826C04A0: state, shaders, each target drawn, the viewport back
0x826C05C8: an occlusion query's begin or end: its result address per tile, EVENT_WRITE_ZPD
0x826C5768: the draws' state group: 0x2203 per tile under its bins, 0x2000, 0x2104
0x826C5BC0: the draws' wait group: VGT 0x2007, the copy registers, a wait, the group's registers
0x826C5D40: the draws' fetch constants (6 dwords a slot) and 0x5000-0x5002
0x826C6C48: the draws' shader flush: constant lists, IM_LOAD, the programs, the patched vertex shader copies
0x826C6A50: a shader part's literal constants (LOAD_ALU_CONSTANT a list entry)
0x826C6010: a vertex shader's fetches remade from the declaration, swizzled, sorted and merged into mini-fetches
0x826C67A0: the vertex shader's exports matched to the pixel shader's inputs (unread ones emptied, registers remapped)
0x826BF670: a clear rect split into an inside aligned to the EDRAM tiles (drawn at their scale) and its edges
0x826BF380: clear rects as rect-list vertices in an allocator block, the clear registers and a predicated auto draw
0x826C5580: the shader control bits (+10432) and the EVENT_WRITE that follows a change
0x826C6B00: a vertex shader's patched copy for the device's state: cache hit, still in use, or patched again
0x826C68E0: a vertex shader copy into the command buffer (IM_LOAD_IMMEDIATE), linked and patched there
0x826C6618: an unread output's export instructions emptied
0x826C66E8: an output's export instructions given the input's register
0x826BAD58: a kicked segment into the primary ring: ring space waited for, an INDIRECT_BUFFER, CP_RB_WPTR (Any360: handed to the command processor directly)
0x826BB1A0: the kick's segment closed (its end packets, its submit) and the next one opened, or a new one from the allocator
0x826BB0C0: a segment's end packets: INVALIDATE_STATE, the segment's end and count into the device's scratch (EVENT_WRITE_SHD)
0x826BB348: a segment submitted: straight to the ring's submit, or chained after the pending ones under the kernel's lock
0x826BA5C8: a segment's 16-byte header written and linked after the last pending one
0x826CE1C8: a tiled recording opened: the segment kicked, its state saved, the tile ops, constant and resource lists started with the tile rects
0x826CE360: a tiled recording closed: a fence whose interrupt hands its lists to the DPC, the lists ended, the work submitted as pending
0x826CD7D8: a tile's bin select (SET_BIN_SELECT_LO) into the ring before its segments' replay (Any360: handed to the command processor)
0x826BD488: the predicated tiling bracket opened: rects, EDRAM tile layout, the clear, the clear values and targets saved, the tiled recording and its loop op, an EVENT_WRITE
0x826BDA38: the predicated tiling bracket closed: each tile resolved under its predication, the DPC's fence and ops, the tiled recording ended
0x826CDAF8: the DPC's tile ops interpreter: each recorded segment submitted once a tile, each tile's bin select, the resources' visibility (any360/xdk/d3d_tiling.h)
